policy: Adopted test files are byte-identical copies of the upstream file at the pinned commit (drift-checked). Excluded test IDs are skipped with a recorded reason because they require non-vendored Hermes infrastructure; no adopted test source is edited.

tools/test_approval.py.covers: approval detection, session allowlists, hardline/dangerous classification, prompting

cron/test_compute_next_run_dst.py.covers: cron next-run computation across DST transitions

cron/test_claim_job_for_fire.py.covers: atomic job claiming for the scheduler tick (create_job/claim_job_for_fire/get_job)

plugins/test_plugin_loader_unreadable.py.covers: plugin loader degrades on unreadable plugin dirs

plugins/test_plugin_storage.py.covers: plugin data dir and per-plugin sqlite storage

gateway/test_whatsapp_identity.py.covers: WhatsApp LID/JID alias expansion via bridge mapping files

gateway/test_pairing.py.covers: pairing code lifecycle, approval store, rate limits, allowlist mirror

tools/test_skills_tool.py.covers: skill discovery/install/view/remove, hub metadata, path security
